fusions.name: Hyphal Tether
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 12 plant damage, slows the target by 40% for 3 seconds and gives it Rot for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Link by Link
fusions.desc: Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back. Fires a spore that deals 7 poison damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Shared Roots
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Passed Along
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, spores leap to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 5 damage, then on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Once every 4 seconds.
